project_info.name: AniEmotion Studio - AI Anime Avatar Generator & Live Face/Speech Tracker
project_info.description: A dark-mode futuristic SaaS studio application in Polish that takes a user photo, generates an anime avatar with emotion variants, and tracks webcam head pose, facial gestures, and voice emotion live.
project_info.theme: Dark Mode Cyber-Anime Studio (Obsidian #0B0E17, Electric Violet #8B5CF6, Cyan Pulse #06B6D4, Neon Coral #F43F5E)

visual_identity.tone_and_feeling: High-tech studio, expressive, energetic, responsive, polished anime aesthetic

layout_and_structure.type: Single-Page Application Studio with tabbed navigation (Studio na żywo, Generuj Avatara, Galeria, Konto)

header.style: Sticky top bar with glassmorphism backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0E17]/80 border-b border-white/10 z-50 px-6 py-3
header.user_menu: Avatar pill + email status + logout button

layout_and_structure.main_grid: Grid col-1 lg:col-span-12 gap-6 p-4 md:p-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto

bento_layout.webcam_preview: col-span-12 md:col-span-4 lg:col-span-3 (Compact camera frame with mesh landmarks overlay toggle)
bento_layout.avatar_viewport: col-span-12 md:col-span-8 lg:col-span-6 (Large animated Canvas/SVG stage showing the reactive anime avatar)
bento_layout.analytics_panel: col-span-12 lg:col-span-3 (Emotion spectrum meters, head pose pitch/yaw/roll stats, live audio transcript with sentiment)

avatar_creator.step_1: Wgraj własne zdjęcie (Upload drag & drop zone)
avatar_creator.step_2: Wybierz podstyle anime (Cyberpunk, Soft Pastel, Shonen Bold, Chibi)
avatar_creator.step_3: Przycisk 'Generuj Avatara Anime' with step-by-step progress animation
avatar_creator.step_4: Podgląd wygenerowanych wariantów emocji (Neutralny, Radość, Smutek, Złość, Zaskoczenie)

live_studio.webcam_card: Video feed with canvas overlay showing MediaPipe landmark dots, camera selector, start/stop tracking button
live_studio.avatar_display: Smooth Canvas/SVG face puppeteer: eyes blink, mouth opens/closes based on audio & webcam pitch/yaw head rotation, emotion switching based on facial expression + voice analysis
live_studio.emotion_meters: Animated progress bars for Joy, Sadness, Anger, Surprise, Neutral with live percentage indicators
live_studio.voice_transcript: Real-time speech transcription box in Polish with detected vocal tone badge
live_studio.controls: Mic toggle, Camera toggle, Sensitivity slider, Calibrate Neutral pose button

avatar_gallery.grid: Card grid displaying user's generated anime avatars with emotion state selectors and preset simulator buttons

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application in React JS using components in src/components/ (JavaScript .js format).
Use Lucide-react icons for UI controls (Video, VideoOff, Mic, MicOff, Sparkles, User, RefreshCw, Layers, Sliders, Activity, Volume2).
Ensure all user-facing strings are in clear Polish language.
Ensure full mock functionality for: face tracking preview, simulated speech-to-text with emotion detection, avatar emotion switching, photo upload avatar generator pipeline.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all interactive elements as mapped out in test_ids.
Maintain high APCA contrast with dark backgrounds (slate-950/obsidian) and vivid neon accents (cyan, pink, violet).
Grid children must be direct children. Use smooth transitions for emotion shifts.
